column1: # BnF fr. 3022 no. 6 (ff. 16v-17v): sign-level reading file, measured by n6_measure.py.
# Tokens are the cipher signs of Lasry's 2026 decryption (prior/BnF_fr3022_f16_decryption.txt, sections 16, 17a,
# 17b, 17va, 17vb), one token per sign, in his labels: a single letter = a letter sign (value from Lasry's key);
# a word label (qve, de, por, con, esta, ha/te ...) = one of his two-per-syllable code signs; [xxx] = nomenclator
# group; <33> <12> <37> = his 'unknown' glyphs; ? = an unlabelled sign (mostly the barred sign, a stop).
# The '_' word breaks and <plaintext> markers of his file are dropped. Checked against Gallica views 32-34
# (hi/c032-c034) on 2026-09-22 where the reading turns on which glyph is written.
# Columns: loc (Lasry section.line) | tokens | reading | status | note
# status: r = read with Lasry's key/labels as they stand; i = read with a value inferred from context in the
#   18 Sept 2026 pass (n6_reading.md); n = read with a value inferred from context or a glyph check in the
#   22 Sept 2026 pass (i and n are grade I: a code identified, or a Lasry label/letter corrected); u = not read;
#   x = sign seen on the image but absent from Lasry's token list (counted, not read); w = the same, read.
# The measure counts tokens: read = r + i + n + w; fraction = read / (all tokens, x and w included).
